# f5xc_discovery (Data Source)

Service discovery in F5XC performs following<br><br>Dynamic service discovery: Resolving the load balancer endpoints for a ADC cluster<br>Dynamic VIP discovery: Publishing virtual IP to attract traffic from clients

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Discovery - Full

data "f5xc_discovery" "example" {
  name      = f5xc_discovery.example.name
  namespace = f5xc_discovery.example.namespace
}
```

- `key_url` (Attributes) Private Key Client private key file containing data in PEM format including the PEM headers. The data in this key file has to match accompanying certificate. The data may be optionally secured using BlindFold. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--discovery_choice--discovery_k8s--access_info--config_type_choice--connection_info--tls_info--key_url))
- `server_name` (String) Server Name ServerName is passed to the server for SNI and is used in the client to check server certificates against. If ServerName is empty, the hostname used to contact the server is used
- `trusted_ca_url` (String) Server CA certificates The URL or value for trusted Server CA certificate or certificate chain Certificates in PEM format including the PEM headers.

<a id="nestedatt--discovery_choice--discovery_k8s--access_info--config_type_choice--connection_info--tls_info--key_url"></a>
### Nested Schema for `discovery_choice.discovery_k8s.access_info.config_type_choice.connection_info.tls_info.key_url`

Read-Only:

- `secret_info_choice` (Attributes) SecretInfoOneof Secret can be one of the following types - * Blindfold Secret - Secret is managed by F5XC Secret Management System * Clear Secret - Secret is not encrypted (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--discovery_choice--discovery_k8s--access_info--config_type_choice--connection_info--tls_info--key_url--secret_info_choice))

Read-Only:

- `blindfold_secret_info` (Attributes) Blindfold Secret Blindfold Secret is used for the secrets managed by F5XC Secret Management Service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--discovery_choice--discovery_k8s--access_info--config_type_choice--connection_info--tls_info--key_url--secret_info_choice--blindfold_secret_info))
- `clear_secret_info` (Attributes) Clear Secret Clear Secret is used for the secrets that are not encrypted (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--discovery_choice--discovery_k8s--access_info--config_type_choice--connection_info--tls_info--key_url--secret_info_choice--clear_secret_info))
- `none` (Boolean) None No private key will be stored or used. Choose this only when you need a public certificate for verification (e.g., validating SAML/JWT signatures). Not suitable for TLS or any use case that requires presenting a certificate, those will fail without a private key.

<a id="nestedatt--discovery_choice--discovery_k8s--access_info--config_type_choice--connection_info--tls_info--key_url--secret_info_choice--blindfold_secret_info"></a>

Read-Only:

- `location` (String) Location Location is the uri_ref. It could be in url format for string:/// Or it could be a path if the store provider is an http/https location
- `store_provider` (String) Store Provider Name of the Secret Management Access object that contains information about the store to get encrypted bytes This field needs to be provided only if the url scheme is not string:///

- `url` (String, Sensitive) URL URL of the secret. Currently supported URL schemes is string:///. For string:/// scheme, Secret needs to be encoded Base64 format. When asked for this secret, caller will get Secret bytes after Base64 decoding.

<a id="nestedatt--discovery_choice--discovery_k8s--access_info--k8s_pod_network_choice"></a>
### Nested Schema for `discovery_choice.discovery_k8s.access_info.k8s_pod_network_choice`

Read-Only:

- `isolated` (Boolean) isolated Specifies Kubernetes POD network is isolated from VER. In this mode NodePort is discovered when Kubernetes cluster is external and ClusterIP is discovered when Kubernetes cluster is in InCluster mode.
- `reachable` (Boolean) Kubernetes Pod reachability Specifies Kubernetes POD is reachable from VER. When POD is reachable, VER always discovers POD IP Address for configured endpoints.



<a id="nestedatt--discovery_choice--discovery_k8s--namespace_mapping_choice"></a>
### Nested Schema for `discovery_choice.discovery_k8s.namespace_mapping_choice`

Read-Only:

- `default_all` (Boolean) Default (Automatic) If configuring in an App Namespace, discovered services across all K8s namespaces will be discovered in the current Namespace
- `namespace_mapping` (Attributes) Custom Select the K8s namespaces from which services will be discovered. If configuring in Shared Configuration, services can be discovered in selected App Namespaces. If configuring in App Namespace services will be discovered in the current Namespace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--discovery_choice--discovery_k8s--namespace_mapping_choice--namespace_mapping))

<a id="nestedatt--discovery_choice--discovery_k8s--namespace_mapping_choice--namespace_mapping"></a>
### Nested Schema for `discovery_choice.discovery_k8s.namespace_mapping_choice.namespace_mapping`

Read-Only:

- `items` (Attributes List) K8S Namespace to App Namespace Mapping Map K8s namespace(s) to App Namespaces. In Shared Configuration, Discovered Services can only be mapped to a single App Namespace, which is determined by the first matched regex. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--discovery_choice--discovery_k8s--namespace_mapping_choice--namespace_mapping--items))

<a id="nestedatt--discovery_choice--discovery_k8s--namespace_mapping_choice--namespace_mapping--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `discovery_choice.discovery_k8s.namespace_mapping_choice.namespace_mapping.items`

Read-Only:

- `namespace` (String) App Namespace Select a namespace
- `namespace_regex` (String) Kubernetes Namespace Regex The regex here will be used to match K8s namespace(s).
